subject.title: fix: harden security and release integrity

question: Should trusted private callback destinations remain supported through an explicit allowlist and upgrade migration, or should this release intentionally make all private-network callbacks unsupported?
rationale: The current hard block improves SSRF resistance but changes an existing integration boundary; choosing the permanent trust model and acceptable upgrade behavior requires maintainer security and compatibility intent.

options.title: Add trusted allowlist and migration
options.body: Block private destinations by default for new configuration while preserving existing trusted callbacks through an explicit scoped allowlist, warnings, and an upgrade path.

options.title: Adopt the breaking prohibition
options.body: Keep the unconditional block, but document the breaking change and prove fresh-install and upgrade behavior for affected self-hosted callback integrations.

recommendation.title: Add trusted allowlist and migration
recommendation.body: Block private destinations by default for new configuration while preserving existing trusted callbacks through an explicit scoped allowlist, warnings, and an upgrade path.
